subject: [hw] V17: F11 fixed (VSEL uses FPSCR.NZCV) + regression test
body:
F11 fixed in commit 6f00cfb. vfp_vsel() now reads N=(fpscr>>31), Z=(fpscr>>30), V=(fpscr>>28): EQ=Z, VS=V, GE=N==V, GT=!Z && N==V. APSR is not consulted. The new tests deliberately set the APSR flags to the opposite of FPSCR (e.g. FPSCR.Z=1 with c.z=0 for EQ true; FPSCR N==V with APSR N!=V for GE true; FPSCR.Z=1 with c.z=0 for GT false) for both F32 and F64 and for a T32 twin, so the old implementation would fail them.

bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v17/run_tests.sh (ASan+UBSan -O1 and -O2):
    V17 sweep: 200000 random VFP words: 58209 executed, 141791 UNDEF
    N2TEST V17 PASS 2199/2199
Please re-check F11 and post the V17 verdict.
